counterfactual.change: Set sensor_noise from 0.0152448 to 0.0 (single field) - removes measurement noise so controller stabilizes pole within limits

explanation: Shrunk scenario violates pole_upright due to sensor_noise 0.015 combined with coarse dt 0.015. Noisy angle measurement corrupts state-feedback controller; with no pushes and nominal plant, system is stable with zero noise but diverges when noise is present. Theta grows from ~-0.16 at step 20 to -0.20 at step 30 then to 0.44 at step 40, 0.71 at step 42, exceeding 0.8 at step 43 (0.86 rad) with high omega ~10 rad/s and cart speed ~8 m/s, while controller force (37-42 N) remains below limit but is ineffective due to noisy feedback. Counterfactual setting sensor_noise to 0 removes failure entirely.
vision_note: The cart stays near the center of the track from step 40 to 43 while the pole leans increasingly to the right. At step 43 the pole tip turns red, visibly marking the pole_upright violation as the angle exceeds the limit.
